balls.text: ends well, aiming for the blockhole again and he just digs it towards extra cover to sneak a single
low full toss on leg stump, all he can do is push it down to long-on for a single
picks the gap, full outside off, makes room and chips it over extra cover in that gap between long-off and deep cover, couple more
makes room and chips it over the in-field and it lands just in front of long-on, a couple of runs
full outside off, moves away to drive him over extra cover, misses
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, gets across to paddle it fine, is hit on the glove and they scramble a single
unlucky is Nannes, bowls it on a length on leg stump, moves away to smack it over midwicket, gets an inside edge to beat Karthik and rolls down the fine-leg boundary
full toss outside off, slashes it towards third man on the bounce, just the single
yorker, just manages to get his bat down in time, digs it out towards the keeper and Karthik does well moving to his right
short on the off, swats it in front of long-on for a single
a boundary for Deccan, finally, full toss outside off, makes room and drives it through extra cover, Mishra covers a fair amount of distance in the deep but the ball beats his dive
short on the off, pulled but straight to midwicket
another one goes, Deccan are sliding at the death, tries to swing it over square leg, doesn't connect well and holes out to Nehra who runs in from fine leg
short on the off, pulled away over square leg, Mishra tumbles in the deep to keep them down to just a single
these are effectively offspinners, gets outside the line to push it wide of midwicket, is struck on the pads
short of a good length outside off, knocks it back past the bowler to long-on
short of a good length outside off, moves across and punches it wide of midwicket
angles it towards middle, chips it wide of midwicket for a single
short on middle, bowled at 139 kmph, goes for the pull, a touch too quick for him, mistimes it in front of midwicket, just the single
dug out in front of extra cover for a quick single

slower one bowled full outside leg stump, tries to tickle it fine, misses, squeezes a leg bye, there is an attempt at the non-striker's end and Warner does brilliantly to back up, moving across from mid-off
short of a length outside off, punched from the crease to extra cover
short on the off, goes for the pull but it's bowled slower and he is into the shot too early
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot and defends it back to the bowler
the slower one does the trick, bowled at 114.8 kmph, tries to flick it over the leg-side field, doesn't pick the change in pace and ends up getting a leading edge to Manhas at square leg
bangs it short on middle, tries to pull it fine, is smacked on the glove, gets a single
fullish on middle, pushed just wide of midwicket but Manhas, who's been brilliant in the field today, hurls to his left to prevent any runs
full outside off, squeezes it out into the deep towards deep cover
short of a good length on the off, drops it down in front of point
full toss on middle, whips it past midwicket for a couple of runs
tossed up on middle, full on the off, defended back to the bowler
the googly, gets outside the line to play it into the leg side, was struck on the pads
swept down towards long leg for a single

gone, round the wicket again, pitches it outside leg stump, Symonds comes down the track, waits for it to turn in and chips it well but straight into the palms of a perfectly positioned Mithun Manhas at long-off
gets his left foot out of the way and pushes it past the bowler for a single
pushed it just outside leg and he drives it towards long-on
yorker length on the off, excellent over this, defended to extra cover
bowls it on a good length outside off at 138 kmph, plays it towards point
short of a good length on middle, pushed toward midwicket
full outside off, angles it down to third man for a single
beautifully driven and equally well fielded, drilled down the ground but Warner at long-on dives full length to his left to keep them down to just one
in the blockhole outside off, digs it out towards cover
gets outside the line of off and taps it in front of point for a single
presents the full face of the bat to drive it to long-off
delicate touches this time, short outside off, waits for it to cut in and late-cuts it behind point, really fine, to the ropes, brings up his half-century
short of a good length on middle, gets on the back foot and defends it back to the bowler
six more, that was the offcutter, the slower one and he picked it, he's feasting on these deliveries bowled on a length and this time, he stretches to smash it wide of long-on
bowls it on a good length on middle, pushed through past the bowler to long-on
Symonds is looking threatening here, tossed up, landed on a length outside off, gets forward and slog-sweeps it miles over the ropes behind midwicket
cracked off the back foot towards long-on for a single
sweeps it away towards deep square leg for a single
full on middle, driven back to the bowler
short on middle, a long hop and he pulls it hard over deep square leg, lands on the rope and is signalled a six, powerful strike
short of a good length on middle, pushed wide of midwicket
bowls it on a good length, pushed through to long-off for a single
the offcutter again, at 94.8 kmph, tucked away towards fine leg for a single
full on middle, driven in the direction of wide long-on for a single
short of a good length outside off, punched from the crease to extra cover
short of a good length on middle, whipped past midwicket into the deep for a couple of runs
the offcutter, pushed towards long-on for a single

ohh, that was close, turned away to flummox Symonds there, he was surprised by the extent of turn there, got a thick edge and it landed just wide of slip, beat the fielder, and rolled down the third-man boundary
that's bludgeoned, tossed up well outside off and he takes it off a length to smash it into the stands over long-off
short of a good length, waits for it to turn and punches it to long-on
and again, converts it into a low full toss and drives it to long-on
flighted on middle, driven down the ground to long-on for a single
appeal for lbw, Mishra slyly slips in the googly and Marsh, playing forward, is struck outside the line as he tries to defend, that can't be given

run-out, it's driven just wide of mid-off where Manhas picks up cleanly and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's end, Mishra was running away from the stumps there, there was no dive either and ends up being well short, Delhi strike again
deft touches, short outside off and he played it late, really late, opening the face at the last moment to guide it just past the diving Karthik to the third-man boundary
short of a length on the off, takes his bottom hand off and drops it in front of point for a single
another one that keeps low and zips under him, bowled quick and had raced through his bat to the keeper
keeps low and Symonds does well to negotiate it, leapt up and brought his bat down in time to tap it to point
short of a length outside off, opens the face to run it down to third man for a single
the googly again, picks it up but a little late, punches it back to the bowler
pushed down the ground to long-off for a single
dropped, a tough chance, flighted outside off and he gives him the charge again, drills it back but Mishra is late to react while turning to his left
pushed off the front foot back to the bowler
flighted outside off and Symonds senses an opportunity, comes down the track, gets to the pitch and dispatches it into the stands over long-off
short of a good length outside off, nips back in, guides it down to third man for a single
four, poor ball there, full outside leg stump and he glances it down to the fine-leg boundary
short of a good length on the off, taps it back to the bowler

he has his revenge, short outside off, bowled much slower at 121.9 kmph, spat off the pitch, more than Rohit would have expected, he tried to cut it past point, ended up getting a thick edge straight into the hands of Karthik
Yadav slips that one down the leg side to concede another run and an extra ball
lovely drive, pitched it up on the off stump, Rohit made a bit of room and crunched it all along the ground wide of mid-off for a boundary
full toss on the off, makes room and thumps it over mid-off for a boundary, easily done, a gift delivery duly punished
thats the googly, he didn't pick it and was struck on the pads but was sliding down the leg side, Delhi have the edge at the end of the Powerplay
well fielded, that was bowled quick and flat outside off, Rohit made a bit of room and forced it towards cover where a diving save kept them to just a single
turning in from a good length outside leg stump, taps it in front of midwicket
comes onto him a little quickly, tries to punch it through the off side, gets a thick outside edge wide of short third man, just the single
short of a length on middle, gets on the back foot and punches it to extra cover
tossed up on middle, gets forward and tickles it in the direction of midwicket for a single
a touch short, makes a bit of way and guides it down towards third man for a single
he's bowling quick here, 145.3 kmph, nips back in sharply to take Mishra on the thighs
shortish on the off, mistimes a pull to midwicket, misfields and concedes a single
tries to work it through the leg side, came onto him a little quickly, was struck on the thighs, that was 145 kmph
shortish on the off, punches it towards extra cover from the crease

...and gets a wicket first ball, short of a good length on middle, moved in after pitching and kept a touch low, Suman was late in bringing his bat down as he tried to whip it through the leg side, missed and the middle stump took a thrashing
had made up his mind there, Nehra fires it on middle and off, Mishra makes room and slices it over point for another boundary
flicks it away wide of a diving short fine leg, who gets a finger to it, a couple
picked the length really early, short on middle, gets into position early, he's on the front foot and swings it away over the ropes over deep square leg for a six
shortish on leg stump, moves away and tries to punch it through the leg side, gets it wide of mid-on
short of a length on middle, goes for the pull, gets an inside edge onto his thighs, they scramble for a single
comes down the track and pushes it towards mid-off for a single, Warner fields well and dives while flicking it to the non-striker's end but misses the stumps, he would have been in anyway
short of a good length outside off, tries to open the face, gets a thick outside edge to beat the wicketkeeper's dive and it rolls over for a single
full on leg stump, tries to drive it through the on side, gets an inside edge onto the pads, it drops into the leg side and they race through for a single
aiming for the blockhole, just outside off, digs it out with a straight bat back to the bowler
targeting middle, pitches it up, Mishra wristily works it wide of mid-on where Warner dives and keeps them to a single
lands on a good length on the off, pushes it towards mid-off again
full outside off, pushed through the line towards mid-off
lazy elegance from Suman there, full outside off and just chips it effortlessly over mid-off for a one bounce four, lovely timing
fullish on middle, plays it back to the bowler, watchfully
gone, short of a good length outside off and he tries to smote that over midwicket, miscues it and Gambhir at mid-off takes a dolly
full outside off, in the slot for Gilchrist and he smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary
lands it on a good length on the off, Gilchrist gets a stride out and defends it hard to cover
slides it on middle and leg, pushed away off the front foot wide of mid-on for a quick single
Gilchrist is away, short on the off and he rocks back to pull it away over square leg for a boundary, comfortably done
short of a length outside off, chops it straight to point
short and wide, Mishra stays in the crease and slashes that towards third man for a single

interesting acrobatics there, full on the off and it's driven firmly back to the bowler, Nannes had lost his balance and was about to fall but in the process, managed to kick the ball away and save a few runs
angling in towards middle and off, holds its line, gets back and defends it to point
full and it is steered through cover into the deep, just the single and Deccan have sealed a place in the semis
low full toss, comes down the track to force it through midwicket, struck on the pads, rolls into the off side, just the single, Delhi are out
full outside off, almost a yorker again, superb over this and Deccan are virtually through, Nehra gets a thick edge, strikes Gilchrist before rolling in front of short third, just the single
superb delivery, full on leg stump, almost yorker length, can't get bat to it, struck on the pads and they can only salvage a leg bye
that cut away from the batsman, Collingwood tried to smash that over square leg but was a touch too wide for him, missed, the crowd has gone quiet
yorker first up, dug out into the leg side and they can only take a single
he doesn't, had made too much room, Harmeet saw that and pushed it full outside off, Nehra just steered it to short third and took the single
full and in the blockhole, all he can manage this time is a single to square leg
A big six, landed on a length on middle, Collingwood stayed in his crease, picked the slower one and dismissed it over deep midwicket, an excellent half-century but he still faces a tough ask
full on middle, smacked hard but straight on the bounce to long-on
another slower one, bowled at 100 kmph, Nehra is too early into that shot as he tries to swat that over long-on, misses
short of a good length on the off, the slower one, slapped to long-off for a single
cheeky Nehra, he had picked his spot, that was bowled full on middle, he shuffled towards off and flicked it over short fine leg for a boundary
in the blockhole outside off, dug out in front of the bowler, thinks of the single but it;s not there
goes for a big heave there, misses and it rolls down to the keeper
it's all happening in Delhi, dropped by Symonds this time, full toss on middle and it's swung away straight to Symonds at deep midwicket who fails to stick on to a low chance diving forward
the slower beamer, slipped out of his hand there, Nehra didn't pick that but ended up fending it towards deep square leg, got a top edge there, they get a single
sweetly struck but straight towards long-on, just the single this time
full on middle, Collingwood drives it hard wide of long-on to scamper back for the second run
bowled flat outside off, slapped it towards long-off for a single
played it back to the bowler
is there a twist in the tale? Rohit dropped it, Collingwood was looking to clear long-off but mistimed it, it was miles in the air and Rohit was in a position to clasp it but couldn't hold on
short on the off, chopped towards point for a single
Nehra's struck some crucial blows in his brief stay so far, that was bowled full and he bent low to slog-sweep that over deep midwicket
turned away, bowled on a good length outside off, came forward to defend but missed

dropped, that was a tag team effort, slower one, Collingwood launches it over wide long-on, Rohit Sharma snaps it but is about to lose his balance and lobs it back to Sumanth just before tripping over the ropes, but Sumanth, in perfect position to catch that, failed to hold on. But wait, that's what it seemed when we saw it live. Replays suggest Rohit may have touched the rope while still holding the ball, so it's a six. One of the moments of the match, nevertheless
the back-of-the-hand slower ball there, full on the off, drilled it back to the bowler who deflected it towards long-on, a couple taken
knocked it through midwicket into the deep for a single
short on the off, tapped to point, Collingwood desperately wants the single but Nehra sends him back
full on middle and he makes room to chip it over midwicket and wide of a diving long-on for a welcome four
Deccan are sailing through here, short outside off, Mishra tries to guide that to third man, gets an inside edge onto the stumps
tries to force it through the off side, gets a thick outside edge to short third man
came down the track and tried to slog-sweep that over midwicket, it held its line to strike him on the pads but appeared to go down the leg side, replays show it would have clipped leg
turned away sharply to surprise the batsman, closed the face on it a little too early, missed
short on the off, punched towards long-on for a single
short, cut behind point for a quick single
appeal for lbw, pushed it quick on middle, Mishra went on the back foot to punch it past midwicket, the inside edge saved him there
quick and short outside off, held the length back, went for the cut, missed
Collingwood breaks the shackles and the crowd roars, flighted on middle, comes down the track and hits through the line to clear long-on
pushed into the leg side wide of the bowler for a single
B Sumanth pulls an excellent effort at long-off, chipped by Mishra and he goes for the catch as it dies on him, manages to get his body behind it and save it from getting it to the ropes
too wide, full outside off and he chases it but misses, called by the umpire though
short of a length on the off, slapped in the direction of deep cover for a single
fullish, driven hard but straight to mid-on, the pressure's growing with every ball
this could be the decisive wicket, short on middle and slid away, Karthik played inside the line to that one, it turned away from middle to hit off, Ojha continues his successful tournament
cracked off the front foot to long-off for a single
Karthik tries to be fancy first up, paddles that straightish delivery in the direction of short fine for a single
punched towards long-off for a single
flighted on middle, comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler
played off the back foot wide of midwicket for a single

run-out, there was pressure building and the quest for a single this time has caused a misunderstanding, short on the off, pushed in front of extra cover, Collingwood is already committed to the single and Manhas responds too late, short and wide, bowled at 114 kmph, drops it in front of point for a single, Marsh returns an easy throw to the bowler who takes down the stumps to find Manhas miles short
full, in the blockhole outside off, dug out towards extra cover
short on the off, turns away, cuts it well but straight to point
quicker one, shortish on the off, pushed wide of a diving extra cover, single
flighted on middle, comes down the track and drives it wide of long-on, a couple more
short of a good length, slapped in front of deep cover who has to run a few yards to his left, they have enough time to run back for the second
full outside off, driven through the line to long-off for a single
the legcutter, holds its line, slides it down the leg side, given a wide
a touch fuller and it nipped back in, tried to drive it through off, got a thick inside edge behind square, the single again
short outside off, cut towards point, beats the fielder's dive but just the single taken
shortish again, pushed gently towards extra cover, dot ball again
hurried onto him there, short of a good length on the off, played it back to Harmeet
gets outside the line and taps it into that vacant area around midwicket for a single
a touch too close to cut, chops it towards point after it turns away
some extra bounce there, knocked it back to the bowler, shortish on the off
fuller, crunched wide of extra cover for a quick single
short of a good length on the off, punched to long-off for one more
short outside off, slaps it towards deep cover for a single
tossed up on the off, eased through to deep point for a single
gave it some air, came down the track and drove it towards long-off for a single
flighted on the off, spun away and Collingwood tapped it in front of the bowler
slides it quick on middle, clipped through square leg, one more
shortish on the off, nudged into the leg side in front of midwicket
tossed up on the off, defended wide of point for a single
short down the leg side, helps it down wide of fine leg for a couple of runs
full on the off, driven down the ground to long-on for a single
bowls it on a good length outside off, pushed gently to extra cover
the offspinner tossed up outside off, driven towards deep point for a single
short of a good length on the off, knocked towards long-on for a single
misfield at extra cover, fullish on the off, driven hard and a single's taken
gets forward and tickles it behind square for a single
typical Collingwood, short and he moves back to just jab it past mid-on, it's timed very well and MItchell Marsh's dive can't save it from going to the boundary
the arm ball bowled short on middle, pushed back to the bowler

The ball's chasing Rohit and he's snapping them up, it's bowled flat outside off and Gambhir comes down the track and swings it to the left of Rohit who stretches, tumbles and holds on to a sharp chance
short of a length outside off, turns in, goes for the cut, misses
short of a good length on the off, punched towards extra cover from the crease
the offspinner, gets forward and jabs it towards midwicket
short and wide, bowled at 114 kmph, drops it in front of point for a single
the offspinner, short outside off, chops it towards point
shortish on leg stump, worked away towards deep square leg for a single
shortish on the off, a hint of away movement, Manhas tries to force it through the leg side but ends up getting a thick edge to third man
bowls it on a good length outside off, gets outside the line and guides it to point
kept a little low, pushed off the back foot wide of midwicket for a single
almost another catch for Rohit, short of a good length and he tries to open the face, it drops just short of slip
short of a good length outside off, guided down towards third man for a single
worked through square leg for a single
excellent start from Manhas who's taken the pressure off with consecutive fours, full outside leg stump, flicks it wide of short fine for another boundary, poor ball
lovely timing, nipped back in and he just pushed through the line to beat the bowler and the diving mid-on

he's given him! Out comes the legcutter but it holds its line,  bowled short of a good length, Dilshan moves across to paddle it fine, misses and is struck on the pads, replays indicate he was struck just in line with off stump after it pitched on the off and it would have gone on to hit the stumps,  the right decision was made and Delhi are in a bit of trouble
angles it towards middle, makes room and punches it to cover
short of a good length on the off, gets back and defends it to point
too straight and he dispatches it fine, on middle and leg and he flicks it wide of short fine leg
short outside off, cut away towards third man for a single to keep the strike
bowls it on middle and leg, flicks it wide of short fine, just the single

What a catch! Rohit makes up for the spill earlier by holding on to a brilliant chance at slip, bowls it on a good length, Sehwag gets forward and tries to push it towards cover, gets a thick edge and Rohit dives full length to his right just as it is dying on him and plucks it with one hand inches from the ground
Sehwag's looking ominous, that was the slower one bowled full and he leant into it to ease it through the covers for a boundary
lands on a good length outside off, a firm push wide of Symonds at mid-off for a single
full and wide, the keeper is still up, driven straight to extra cover
full outside off, there is cover in the deep this time, driven through to deep extra cover for a single
smashed, lands on a good length outside off, stand and deliver from Dilshan as he hammers it between cover and point, no stopping that
bowls it on a good length outside off, pushed towards cover from the crease
angles it on the pads, tries to whip it square, is struck on the pads, would have slid down

gone, Rohit holds on this time but it's a different batsman, length ball outside off, gets a thick outside edge and Rohit, moving to his left, fails to clasp it in his first attempt but juggles to hold on while falling over
and is duly dispatched after he gifts Warner an overpitched delivery, it's smashed back along the ground wide of mid-off
he senses a chance with that pitched up delivery outside off, clears his left foot and thumps it over extra cover
short of a good length on middle, punches it back to the bowler
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot and pushes it back to the bowler
edged and dropped, Rohit has spilled what was an extremely touch catch, full and wide, Sehwag goes after it, gets a thick outside edge and Rohit flings himself to his right but can't hold on
bowled it on a good length outside off, tries to drive it through extra cover, gets a thick inside edge towards midwicket for a single
some swing away from the batsman, pushed it full on the off, played it towards mid-on
